Definition: from G1537 and G4762; to pervert (figuratively):--subvert.
BiblicalUsage: ekstréphō means to pervert, to subvert. In Titus 3:11, the text says "Knowing that he that is such is subverted."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, ekstréphō means to pervert, to subvert, and I leave it at that.
